name: Maven and Gradle
description: JVM packages: the Maven and Gradle projects in a folder, what each declares, what is newer on Maven Central or your own repositories, and search across Maven Central.
detail: Reads your POMs, Gradle build scripts, version catalog, Gradle lockfiles, ~/.m2/settings.xml and gradle.properties. Neither Maven nor Gradle has a command that adds a dependency, so this plugin only resolves them, through the mvn or gradle on your machine, in a terminal you can see.
